Title: systemID
Description: unique system ID number (because some systems have duplicate names)

Title: alternateName
Description: Alternate names of the system, name changes (with year), and/or notable worlds within the system

Title: x
Description: X-ordinate for mapping purposes as extracted from official maps

Title: y
Description: y-ordinate for mapping purposes as extracted from official maps

Title: size
Description: reference size (in LY) of a system/cluster for mapping purposes, [width,height,rotation]. Widths and heights are from center to edge, not edge to edge

Title: sarnaSystemLink
Description: URL of the entry in www.sarna.net

Title: distance (LY)
Description: based on the coordinates, the linear distance of the system from a reference point indicated in cell H1 (Sol by default)
